task_description: Issue #43: time-of-day and state-aware stage background. Switch the stage background gradient by device local time (morning/day/evening/night), dim when sleeping, show a subtle grime vignette when dirty, and shift the theme per growth stage. Pure unit-tested timeOfDay helper + data-attributes/classes + pure CSS. Hard acceptance: respect prefers-reduced-motion, WCAG AA text contrast on every phase, no mobile perf regression. Frontend-only; redeploy frontend after merge.

verification.summary: npm run build exit 0 (TS strict). Shared tests 152/152, frontend 123/123 (120 baseline + 3 new timeOfDay boundary tests). The 3 new tests exercise the real timeOfDay helper across every phase boundary (4,5,9,10,16,17,19,20,23,0), Date inputs, and non-finite fallback, and would fail if the hour ranges were wrong, so they are meaningful. No Dockerfile for the frontend package, so docker_build skipped. Semantic review v1 verdict APPROVED with no blocking issues.
